for (let levels = 0; levels <= 3; levels++) {
  let prototype = Object.create(null);
  for (let index = 0; index < levels; index++) prototype = Object.create(prototype);
  for (const value of [[], [1, 2], new Map([[1, 2]]), new Set([1])]) {
    Object.setPrototypeOf(value, prototype);
    console.dir(value, { depth: 1 });
  }
}
const sparse = [1, , 3];
Object.defineProperty(sparse, '1', { value: 2, enumerable: false });
Object.defineProperty(sparse, '4', { get() { throw new Error('array getter ran'); }, enumerable: true });
Object.assign(sparse, { note: 'own' });
Object.setPrototypeOf(sparse, Object.create(null));
console.dir(sparse, { depth: 2, showHidden: true });
console.log(sparse);
const many = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8];
Object.setPrototypeOf(many, Object.create(null));
console.dir(many, { depth: 2, maxArrayLength: 1 });
const detached = [[1, 2], new Map([[1, 2]]), new Set([1])];
for (const value of detached) Object.setPrototypeOf(value, null);
console.log(detached);
const arrayWithProperties = [7, 8];
Object.setPrototypeOf(arrayWithProperties, {});
console.log(arrayWithProperties);
const inherited = [7, 8];
Object.setPrototypeOf(inherited, Object.create(Array.prototype));
console.log(inherited);
